<description>
`EventLoop::loop()` exits when its reference count reaches zero. In `serve()` mode, the parent connection is the only reference keeping the loop running. Other `CapnpProtocol` methods called from threads not handling parent IPC requests do not hold their own references and therefore depend on the parent connection remaining alive.

Add `loopRef()` (code suggested by @ryanofsky in https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/376#discussion_r4268952676), which returns a new reference to the event loop or throws if the loop is not running or is shutting down, and use it in the methods that need the loop. Protect `m_loop` with a new `m_loop_mutex` to prevent `serve()` from destroying the loop while `loopRef()` is accessing it.
</description>
